original.question: What happens after Paul stretches on the young man?

20:9 And a certain young man named Eutychus, seated in the window, was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell from the third story and was picked up dead.
20:10 But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”

proposal.note: “Stretches on” could be replaced with “throws himself on,” but that would not resolve the reported answer-support concern. Wording alone cannot make the fixed answer, “He comes back to life,” unambiguous without changing the tested fact or the supplied passage.

“迦勒第一次说有人来时，西布说迦勒看见的其实是什么？”确实要求区分两人的角色，但直接重复“迦勒”和“西布”使角色明确，不必解析含混的代词指向；这一角色区分也是题目所需。
“迦勒……说有人来”与“西布说……”构成报告和回应两层话语。读者只需辨认谁报告、谁解释，没有额外嵌入的第三方观点，层次可直接掌握。
“第一次”需要与后面的“迦勒又说”相区分，但它是明确而简短的时间定位，能减少所问对象的歧义，而非增加可避免的指代负担。
